Array of subscribed position holders used by subscription contracts.

Permission check comparing src against address(this), owner and authority.canCall.
Owner-only initial admin assignment.

Admin-only ownership transfer.

edges.reason: DSAuth/AdminAuth constructors assign owner from msg.sender, making the caller the initial privileged account.
isAuthorized is invoked with msg.sender via the auth modifier, so the caller controls the permission check input.
DFSProxy.callProxy indexes nonces by caller-supplied _user correlated with msg.sender and signature.
auth modifier guards setOwner through isAuthorized, preventing unauthorized ownership change.
auth modifier guards setAuthority through isAuthorized, preventing unauthorized authority change.
isAuthorized compares src against the stored owner address to grant permission.
isAuthorized falls back to authority.canCall to decide permission.
setOwner writes the owner state variable with the provided address.
setAuthority writes the authority state variable with the provided address.
setAdminByOwner writes the admin state variable, checked against owner.
setAdminByAdmin reassigns admin, checked against current admin.
setOwnerByAdmin changes owner, checked against admin.
Owner-only kill invokes selfdestruct, permanently destroying the contract.
kill sends remaining funds to the owner address.
callExecute invokes DSProxy.execute on an external contract which can reenter before state settles.
callExecute forwards leftover ETH to msg.sender after the external call, enabling reentrant draining.
onlyMonitor modifier restricts callExecute to the registered monitor address.
setMonitor writes the monitor state variable, restricted to allowed users.
changeMonitor records now (block.timestamp) into changeRequestedTimestamp, making timing miner-influenceable.
confirmNewMonitor requires changeRequestedTimestamp + CHANGE_PERIOD < now, a timestamp dependency.
confirmNewMonitor promotes newMonitor into the monitor state variable.
revertMonitor restores monitor from lastMonitor.
changeMonitor sets changeRequestedTimestamp to the current block time.
changeMonitor stores the requested address in newMonitor.
cancelMonitorChange clears newMonitor back to address(0).
Discount.setServiceFee requires msg.sender == owner before writing service fees.
callProxy validates and consumes the nonce to prevent signature replay.
callProxy uses ecrecover against the EIP712 digest to authenticate the caller.
callProxy forwards value and calls DSProxy.execute, invoking arbitrary external code.
givePermission may create a guard and call setAuthority, mutating the proxy authority.
removePermission reads the current authority and forbids the caller in the guard.
getFee consults BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to select the automatic service fee.
Fee branching is driven by tx.origin, an origin-controlled input that can be spoofed indirectly.
getFee transfers collected fees to the wallet address as ETH or ERC20.
repayFor makes an external proxy call with value, an entry point for reentrancy.
boostFor makes an external proxy call with value, an entry point for reentrancy.
takeOrder low-level calls exchangeAddr forwarding ETH, allowing reentrant behavior.
getBestPrice performs low-level calls to arbitrary wrapper addresses.
withdrawStuckFunds is owner-only and transfers tokens/ETH out of the contract.
subscribe appends the caller position to the subscribers array and index map.
Compound subscribe appends caller subscription to the subscribers array.
unsubscribe route mutates the subscribers array through _unsubscribe.
_unsubscribe swaps the last subscriber into the removed slot and pops the array.
DSProxyCache.write deploys a contract via assembly create, external code execution.
kill is restricted to msg.sender == owner before selfdestruct.
repayFor/boostFor onlyApproved checks msg.sender against the bot registry.
callProxy onlyAuthorized ties execution to msg.sender authorization.

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is the address parameter that is directly written into the owner state variable by setOwner.
authority_ is the address parameter that is directly written into the authority state variable by setAuthority.
currAuthority is a purely local helper holding the current authority used only inside givePermission.
_newMonitor is the requested monitor parameter stored into newMonitor by changeMonitor.
